title: Random Paintings
description: Changes all of the paintings in the game as of 1.21.9 to whenever more paintings come.
body:
This texture pack changes all of the paintings in the game as of 1.21.7 (i think) to whenever more paintings come. 
This takes some both AI, games or google and makes it into paintings in game. 

This is for anyone looking to have fun exploring every painting in the library of them and seeing what mess I've done with each and every one of them. (i also use it on every single server ive made like ever and people love it so)

I've had this on my pc and used it for a while but didn't think of uploading it here so uhh, guess this is here now.

If the paintings don't change/work, at least if you have moved the pack down in the pack menu a bit it gets lower priority, or if you put on a new pack over it changing the paintings it will ALWAYS get overridden if it has a paintings folder in its files.
